entities.summary: Bergouey-Viellenave is a commune of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department in southwestern France. It was created in 1973 by the merger of three former communes: Bergouey, Arancou and Viellenave-sur-Bidouze. Arancou was re-established in November 1977.
